data.description: A lama matriarch drains 1d4 points of Wisdom each time she hits with her melee touch attack.  The first time each round that she strikes a foe with a melee weapon, she also drains 1 point of Wisdom.  A DC %1 Will save negates the Wisdom drain.  Unlike with other kinds of ability drain attacks, a lamia matriarch does not heal damage when she uses her Wisdom drain.
data.name: Wisdom Drain
